Crude sodium nitrate is known as Chile Saltpetre. Profile Sodium nitrate has similar actions to potassium nitrate (p.1658) and is used as a preservative in foods, particularly in meat prod- ucts. Crude sodium nitrate is used as a fertiliser. Handling. Sodium nitrate has been used for the illicit prepara- tion of explosives or fireworks; care is required with its supply. Poisoning.
